description: Show verified local prompt-cache usage and diagnose Responses API cache misses.

defaultPrompt: Set up Cache Stats on this Windows computer.
Show cache usage for the previous response.
Help me diagnose this Responses API prompt cache miss.
interface.longDescription: See cached input, non-cached input (including cache writes), and newly generated output for the previous verified response. Cache Stats also helps developers request and interpret Responses API prompt-cache diagnostics for GPT-5.6 and later supported models, including GPT-6. Its Windows helper is local-only, verifies the active task, and never claims to reconstruct an API diagnostic result.

name: cache-stats
